items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I do not like that at all. I‘m not a diva.

ctx.x: I do not like that at all. I‘m not a diva. I‘m a musician, you know, and as I say, I like to hang in with the guys and play. But a diva? I‘m no diva. Shit, I‘m not a diva. I‘m a musician.
